company.what_they_do: StackOne is an AI Agent Integration Platform. It provides developers and AI teams with pre-built connectors (450+, 28,000+ actions) to connect AI agents to enterprise SaaS systems (HRIS, ATS, CRM, LMS, IAM, etc.). The platform handles authentication (OAuth, SAML, API keys), permission scoping, prompt injection defense, audit logging, tool discovery, and token optimization — so that AI agents can reliably execute real-world workflows across enterprise apps without teams needing to build or maintain integrations themselves. It connects to AI clients and frameworks including Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean via MCP, A2A, or REST API. The platform also includes a custom AI Integration Builder (using a 'Falcon' execution engine) that can generate production-ready connectors from a prompt. Key pillars marketed as Connect, Secure, and Optimize.
raw_notes: 450+ pre-built connectors, 28,000+ actions, 100k+ evals using real agent prompts to guarantee quality
Handles auth: OAuth, SAML, API keys, scopes — all in a single interface
Custom connector/action builder: build for any API in minutes
Connects via MCP, A2A, or REST API to Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, Glean, and more
Trigger agentic workflows on any app event — filtered, enriched, trimmed; no polling
Prompt Injection Guard: claims 89% catch rate on malicious tool responses
Per-user tool scoping, field customization, access grants — governance layer
Full observability: request tracing, audit logs, real-time monitoring
Runs in any region (AWS, GCP, Azure); cloud-based or self-hosted; no customer data stored by default
Token optimization: cuts token usage by up to 80% via tool discovery (surfaces only relevant tools)
S1 Search Bench: 91.6% first-try accuracy on agentic semantic tool search
Falcon execution engine: self-improving, optimized for agentic tool calling
AI Integration Builder: researches provider APIs, generates production-ready configs, tests against real APIs from your coding assistant
Free tier: Gateway Starter includes 1,000 credits/seat/month + all 400+ pre-built connectors
Paid tiers: Team (AI Connector Builder, A2A, Defender Premium, SAML SSO), Enterprise (custom credits, audit logs with SIEM export, on-prem), OEM Core (embed in own product)
Founded 2023 by Romain Sestier (CEO) and Guillaume Lebedel (CTO), both ex-Google/Oracle/Yieldify

Raised $24M total: $3.6M seed (Episode 1 Ventures, Playfair, Portfolio Ventures) + $20M Series A led by GV (Google Ventures); also Workday Ventures, XTX Ventures, angels from OpenAI, DeepMind, Microsoft, MuleSoft
Incorporated in England and Wales; team distributed across Europe and US
Headcount estimated ~57 employees (RocketReach) or 11–50 range (other sources)
Named customers/case studies include: Drata (compliance automation), Kinfolk (AI for People Ops), Introist (HR automation)
Use cases highlighted: invoice processing, post-demo follow-up, SLA breach prediction/escalation, employee onboarding, job posting distribution
Competitors cited: Paragon, Cloud Elements, Composio
Blog post 'Bring AI Agents to Work with StackOne' (Aug 2025) describes internal dogfooding of MCP-powered platform called 'Disco'
